models.notes: Average by slot role of 12 per-set Play Booster models (main-set outcomes only; Special Guests/bonus-sheet outcomes dropped and renormalised). Typical structure: 6-7 commons (1.5-2% Special Guest replacement), 3 uncommons, 1 rare/mythic (mythic ~13%), 1 non-foil wildcard (C ~12-20 / U ~58-66 / R ~16-20 / M ~2.5), 1 foil wildcard (C ~55-60 / U ~30-35 / R ~6.5-8 / M ~1.1), 1 land (20% foil), 14 cards + token. Expressed as an expected-composition model: each slot is one (rarity, finish, treatment) class with count = mean expected number of cards of that class per pack (fractional); EV = sum(count x avg price of the class) is identical to what a slot-by-slot model of the averaged sets would give. Special Guests / The List / Commander-deck / bonus-sheet cards are dropped (their share is a few percent of a card per pack).

notes:
HOW TO USE (read first)
EV(pack) = sum over slots of  slot.count * sum over outcomes of  p * AVG_PRICE(pool(outcome), outcome.finish).
pool(outcome) = TCGplayer MTG products where: group name in (outcome.set_names, else model.applies_to.set_names); product Rarity (extendedData) in outcome.rarity; product name matches outcome.name_regex (re.search; PCRE-style negative look-aheads are used) if present; product name with parenthetical suffixes stripped is in card_lists[outcome.card_list] if present; and the product has a market price for outcome.finish. Slot 'count' may be fractional where pack composition varies (expected number of cards). Outcome p sums to 1 within each slot.
SCHEMA EXTENSIONS beyond PACK_MODEL_FORMAT.md: outcome.treatment (human label), outcome.set_names (override group), outcome.card_list (key into top-level card_lists = list of card names restricting the pool, used for bonus-sheet/Special Guests/The List/Commander-deck cards and for slots whose pool is a strict subset of the TCGplayer rarity class, e.g. MKM rare slot excludes rare dual lands, FRA rare slot excludes echoed-pair rares), fractional slot.count, pack type 'beyond' (Assassin's Creed Beyond Booster), top-level treatment_regex.
TREATMENTS: TCGplayer lists showcase/borderless/extended-art/retro-frame versions as separate products with the SAME rarity letter, with the treatment in parentheses at the end of the product name. 'Regular' = no such suffix (name_regex negative look-ahead); 'Borderless/Showcase' = (Borderless) or (Showcase) products (merged because TCGplayer's Showcase-vs-Borderless naming disagrees with Scryfall's frame data in several sets, e.g. DSK, MSH, SPM); 'Extended Art'; 'Retro Frame'; 'Serial Numbered'; 'Foil Etched'; 'Exotic Foil' = any other foil-only product (Textured/Fracture/Surge/Ripple/Raised/Galaxy/Halo/Dragonscale/Neon Ink/Invisible Ink...). FINAL FANTASY merges Extended Art into 'Borderless/Showcase/Extended Art' because the two buckets disagree between Scryfall and TCGplayer there. Treatment buckets were validated against TCGplayer product lists for MKM, OTJ, MH3, BLB, DSK, FIN, SPM, MSH, FRA, TDM, EOE, TLA, ECL and HOB: product counts per Extended Art bucket match Scryfall exactly (+-1) in every set except FIN, and Borderless+Showcase counts agree within ~10% (Scryfall flags ~10% more cards than TCGplayer suffixes; those cards are plain-named on TCGplayer). Bucket mapping for the other sets (all pre-2024 sets, ACR, PIP, INR, TMT, SOS, FDN, DFT) is by analogy and was not checked against TCGplayer names. If an outcome's pool is empty (a handful of sub-0.1% chase outcomes, e.g. headliner/serialized names that TCGplayer has not listed, retro-frame lands), drop it and renormalise the slot; if a whole treatment bucket's regex matches no products the script should fall back to the union regex 'Borderless|Showcase|Extended Art|Retro Frame' for booster-fun outcomes.
FINISH: 'Foil' = traditional foil and every exotic foil (price subtype Foil on TCGplayer; etched foils also Foil); 'Normal' = non-foil.
RARITY: TCGplayer letters. Basic lands = L AND the common dual-land cycles = L (TCGplayer labels both 'L' - verified on OTJ/DSK/SPM product lists);  Special Guests / The List / bonus-sheet cards use the rarity of the printing but are restricted by set_names + card_list.
MODEL SELECTION: match a TCGplayer group to a model by applies_to.set_names (exact group name) and pack type (play/collector for 2024+, draft/set/collector for 2020-2023, beyond for Assassin's Creed). Sets with no per-set model: use mtg-play-generic / mtg-collector-generic (2024-11-15 onward) or the *-generic-2020-2023 models; the Mystery Booster / Jumpstart / Secret Lair / Commander-only products have no model. NAME MATCHING for card_list: lower-case, strip all parenthetical suffixes, use the front face (text before ' // ') of double-faced/split names.
OTHER CAVEATS: (a) '<1%' / 'less than 1%' chase items (serialized, singularity/galaxy/halo/dragonscale/textured/neon-ink foils, facet foil) use mtg.wtf's rate, usually 0.01-1%; Wizards publishes no more precise figure. MKM serialized was capped to 0.02% by me. Set those outcomes to 0 if you want a conservative EV. (b) Bonus-sheet groups whose TCGplayer products carry no treatment suffix (OTP, Mystical Archive, Stellar Sights, Through the Ages, Eternal-Legal and Source Material groups, Retro Frame Artifacts, Multiverse Legends...) use name_regex AnyNonExotic. (c) Japanese-language variants of Japan Showcase cards are counted with the English ones. (d) Reality Fracture echoed-pair borderless R/M odds and Star Trek '<1%' items are estimates, see those models. (e) 2020-2023 per-set models and ACR/PIP/WHO are mtg.wtf reconstructions that were not cross-checked against Wizards article numbers except LCI and WOE (and ACR/PIP structure, read from their Wizards articles).
NOT MODELED: the 15th non-card item (token / ad / art card / punch-out; art cards moved to Collector Boosters after Aetherdrift, Play Boosters no longer have ad cards), Box Toppers, Prerelease/Bundle/Commander/Jumpstart/Arena products, 'Epilogue'/Beyond products other than Assassin's Creed, MB2/MB1 Mystery Boosters. FUTURE: Wizards announced (2026-10-05, 'Updating Our Boosters in 2027') a new Booster Pack format from Feb 2027 (Nauctis: The Sunken Realm) - no guaranteed foil, God Packs (reported 1 in 1,000 packs / 1 in 300 Collector Boosters), higher foil R/M rates - NOT modeled; Star Trek (2026-11-13) predates the change and has a hand-built model; Marvel: Darkhold Destiny (2027-04-09) and later sets will use the new format and have no model here.
SOURCES AND CONFIDENCE: (1) Wizards 'Collecting <Set>' articles = official percentages (Play Booster rarity splits for wildcard/foil slots are published from Foundations on; for MKM/OTJ/BLB/DSK only structure and treatment frequencies are published). (2) mtg.wtf sheet models (fan site) were used to expand the published percentages into per-card sheets and to fill unpublished splits; they reproduce Wizards' numbers to within rounding in every case I checked (MH3, FDN, DFT, TDM main-set part, FIN, EOE, SPM, TLA, ECL, TMT, SOS, MSH, INR, MKM/LCI/WOE/FDN/TDM/EOE/BLB collector; see verification_vs_wizards_articles) with one exception: TDM's non-foil wildcard treatment shares were ~1.5-1.9 points off and are overridden with the article numbers. (3) Scryfall = rarity and frame data of each sheet card. (4) tcgcsv/TCGplayer product names = regex design.
Generic fallback models (set_names empty) are plain averages of the per-set models and are marked 'estimate'.
